breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use beta = 1/T_film where T_film is in degrees Celsius (i.e., beta = 1/50 per °C).' This directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires beta = 1/T_abs where T_abs is the film temperature in Kelvin (323.15 K), not in Celsius (50°C). The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
